answer: Make every identity post a small refundable bond and finish one costly, non-parallelizable verification job before earning. An attacker crossing this canyon of cost must pay the bond and compute for each fake, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand times more, while honest agents earn the bond back through verified work. The reward, the nectar of the economy, flows only to identities whose past work checks out, and a saffron audit flag freezes suspicious batches for review.
